Asif : Go along---come to crossroads---turn left---go about two hundred
metres-tall building --station on the right. Thank you very much.
Passer-by : It’s OK.

there. Start like this:
Sl: Excuse me. How can I go to Mosque Road?
Oh, it’s quite far
